done_when: A pull request that changes only JavaScript or TypeScript test files (such as *.test.ts and *.spec.ts) runs one CI test group with those tests, as a docs-only change does, and a change to any other code keeps today's group choice; new repos get it at init and existing repos on upgrade and forge sync
why: In a TypeScript app, a pull request that changes only test files still runs every CI test group, because the CI group choice recognises only Python test file names
